scope: Current private Managerial Download Game Data CSV

fields.name: runID
fields.events: All events
fields.definition: Local run identifier shared by rows from one run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Group by game and runID; this is not a student identifier.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: game
fields.events: All events
fields.definition: Game title recorded by the game.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Use with questionID because IDs are game-specific.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: mode
fields.events: All events
fields.definition: Internal game-mode name.
fields.possibleValues: standard, timed, exam, score, practice, legendary, quiz, fadingFortune, riskReward and other supported modes
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: A trailing -complete suffix is removed; use event to identify completion.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: event
fields.events: All events
fields.definition: The action represented by this row.
fields.possibleValues: question, rapid_guessing, start, resume, exam_answer_initial, exam_answer_revision, completion and mechanic events
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Use question for accepted responses. See event guidance below.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.events: All events
fields.definition: Time the local record was saved, in UTC.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Exam commits are recorded at commitment, not necessarily initial selection.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: room
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Game room or section position attached to the event.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Context may remain on non-question rows; not a unique question ID.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: questionID
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Numeric question identifier within the game.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Zero means no question supplied; spelling is questionID in this CSV.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Supplied question difficulty, current-question fallback, or mode fallback.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: May describe the current question on unrelated events; compare within the same game.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: tag
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Question concept/tag label.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Group accepted responses by concept; empty on many lifecycle rows.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: type
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Question's instructional type label.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Use accepted question rows; this is not a graph-required flag.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: objective
fields.events: Question-related events; defaults on other rows
fields.definition: Learning objective supplied or inferred for the question.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Use for instructional grouping; names may vary across games.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: selectedIndex
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Selected answer option, counted from zero.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: 0 is the first option; -1 means no selected index supplied. Exam drafts can contain a choice.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: correct
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Whether the response was correct.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use question rows. Other event types, including exam drafts and completion, normalize to 0; these are not incorrect answers.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: rapidGuessing
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Whether the response was flagged as a rapid guess.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: rapid_guessing rows are rejected attempts; do not include them as accepted question responses. A flag is not evidence of intent.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: attempt
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Game's cumulative attempt counter at the event.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Not a per-question attempt number; also supplied on summaries. Defaults to 0 when omitted.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: streak
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Current consecutive-correct streak recorded by the engine.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Timing of the snapshot follows the event producer; not the run maximum.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: score
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Current mode score or bankroll supplied by the game.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Risk & Reward uses bankroll; Fading Fortune uses its score. Other rows may fall back to Score Attack state; compare like modes only.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: bestScore
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Stored Score Attack best score.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: May carry prior-run/browser state even in other modes; not this run's maximum score.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: elapsedTimeMs
fields.events: question and rapid_guessing; see individual notes
fields.definition: Run elapsed time supplied at the event.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Completion events use supplied totalTime; other events use supplied elapsedTime. Zero is a default when omitted; distinct from response duration.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: adaptiveMode
fields.events: Question-related events and current game-state fallbacks
fields.definition: Adaptive context label supplied by the event or current engine state.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Includes exam-commit and completion labels; this is not a numerical mastery estimate.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: remediationStage
fields.events: Question-related events and current game-state fallbacks
fields.definition: Explicit remediation stage or current active-remediation stage.
fields.possibleValues: Stage label such as repair, bridge, retest, or blank
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Blank commonly means no active stage. Do not infer a separate exported boss or bridge column.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: priorExposureCount
fields.events: Question-related events and current game-state fallbacks
fields.definition: Earlier stored question or rapid_guessing rows for the same questionID in this local run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Counts rejected rapid guesses too; limited to retained records, not lifetime exposure.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: firstExposure
fields.events: Question-related events and current game-state fallbacks
fields.definition: 1 when a positive questionID has no earlier stored response rows in this run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: 0 means previous exposure or no question ID; use question rows and priorExposureCount together.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: totalTimeMs
fields.events: Run summary events: complete, mode completions, early endings or busts where supplied
fields.definition: Total run duration supplied by the summary producer.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Not a sum of response times; also populated on early-ending summaries.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.events: Run summary events: complete, mode completions, early endings or busts where supplied
fields.definition: Run accuracy supplied as a proportion.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: 0.8 means 80%; format as a percentage in a spreadsheet. Non-summary rows default to 0; this is not objective-level mastery.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: maxStreak
fields.events: Run summary events: complete, mode completions, early endings or busts where supplied
fields.definition: Longest correct-answer streak reported for the run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use summary rows; other events default to 0.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: totalAttempts
fields.events: Run summary events: complete, mode completions, early endings or busts where supplied
fields.definition: Total attempts reported in the run summary.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use the same summary's accuracy; do not sum this cumulative value across rows.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: verificationCode
fields.events: Run summary events: complete, mode completions, early endings or busts where supplied
fields.definition: Game-generated completion/report code.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Helps compare a report with its local export; not secure identity verification.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneScore
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Cumulative points earned for correct Fading Fortune answers.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Available on responses and summaries; compare within this mode.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneQuestionValue
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Points available for the question at response.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Value can decrease as answer options fade.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneFadeCount
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Number of fades recorded for this question.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Zero on a measured mode response means no fade.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneIntervalMs
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Configured interval between question fades.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Game-mechanic timer, not measured response time.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortunePausedDurationMs
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Paused time accumulated by the Fading Fortune gameplay timer.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Not hiddenTimeMs; visible pauses may be included in telemetry time.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneMaxScore
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Summary maximum: question target multiplied by 100.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: A theoretical target, not observed score; summary only.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneAverageValue
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Rounded average available question value across completed questions.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Includes incorrect answers; not average points earned. Summary only.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: fadingFortuneDistribution
fields.events: Fading Fortune response rows; summary fields only on Fading Fortune run summaries
fields.definition: Summary counts of answered questions at each available point value.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Includes correct and incorrect answers. Blank outside supplied summaries.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardBankrollBefore
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Bankroll before the current wager.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use response rows; wager-committed events do not supply this exported field under this name.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardWagerAmount
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Points staked on the current question.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use response rows; do not assume the wager-committed event populates this column.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardWagerPercent
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Rounded percentage of bankroll chosen for the wager.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: 25 means 25%, not 0.25.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardWagerTier
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Wager tier label for the selected fraction.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Tier is a game choice, not a measure of student risk preference.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardBankrollAfter
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Bankroll after answer settlement.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Rejected rapid guesses can precede settlement; use accepted question rows.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardAllIn
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Whether the current wager used essentially the entire bankroll.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use response rows in this mode; 0 elsewhere may be a default.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardStartingBankroll
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Starting bankroll supplied in the run summary.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; game points, not money.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardFinalBankroll
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Bankroll remaining at the run summary.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; 0 may mean a bust in this mode.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardNet
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Final bankroll minus starting bankroll.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; negative values represent a net loss.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardPeakBankroll
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Highest bankroll recorded during the run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; not final bankroll.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardLargestWager
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Largest single wager committed in the run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; not a total of wagers.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardAllInAttempts
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Count of all-in wagers committed.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; counts wager choices, not necessarily distinct completed questions.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardBusted
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Whether the run summary reports a bust.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Use this mode's summary event; unrelated rows default to 0.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardQuestionsCompleted
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Number of questions completed in the wager run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; may be below the target after early ending or bust.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardTarget
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Planned question count for the wager run.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.
fields.notes: Summary only; not the observed completion count.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: riskRewardWagerDistribution
fields.events: Risk & Reward response rows; run-level fields only on Risk & Reward summaries
fields.definition: Summary count of committed wagers by tier.
fields.blankMeaning: Unavailable in older data or not supplied; see event and mode.
fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Counts choices; not correctness or an intent score.
fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: responseTimeMs
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Total elapsed telemetry response interval on newly measured rows.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: Includes hidden time and visible modal/graph time. Legacy rows retain gameplay timing: require nonblank activeResponseTimeMs for current semantics.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent. Older rows preserve different gameplay-clock semantics.

fields.name: activeResponseTimeMs
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Response interval spent with the document visible.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: Visible is not proof of attention; window focus is separate.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent.

fields.name: hiddenTimeMs
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Accumulated time the document was hidden.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: Includes a still-open hidden interval at submission; capped at total interval.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent.

fields.name: tabSwitchCount
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Distinct visible-to-hidden transitions during the interval.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: A hidden document does not reveal destination or reason; starting hidden does not count as a switch.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent.

fields.name: timeAfterReturnMs
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Time from final return to visibility until submission.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: Blank if never returned or still hidden. Exam aggregates follow the view aggregation rules below.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent.

fields.name: focusLossCount
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Distinct window blur transitions.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
fields.zeroMeaning: Measured zero duration/count or false indicator; does not mean unavailable.
fields.notes: Window focus loss can occur while the document remains visible.
fields.caution: Interaction evidence is not proof of attention or intent.

fields.name: unfocusedTimeMs
fields.events: Measured question, rapid_guessing, exam_answer_initial/revision rows; exam-commit question rows aggregate views
fields.definition: Accumulated time between window blur and refocus.
fields.blankMeaning: Not measured, not applicable, older row, or a required return/copy/transition has not occurred.
